# Drive Dojo Driving School

Drive Dojo is an automatic driving school based in East London. A DVSA-approved driving instructor teaches automatic driving lessons in a Mercedes-Benz A-Class across Canary Wharf and surrounding East London areas. Learners book online and can pay with Klarna.

## About
- Business type: Automatic driving school
- Instructor status: DVSA-approved driving instructor (ADI)
- First-time pass rate: 98%
- Students taught: 200+
- Google rating: 5/5 from 200+ reviews

## Location
- Base: Canary Wharf, London E14
- Service area: East London, including Canary Wharf, Isle of Dogs, Docklands, Goodmayes, Ilford, Barking, East Ham, Forest Gate, Canning Town, Walthamstow and Romford

## Services
- Automatic driving lessons
- Beginner lessons
- Intensive driving courses
- Mock driving tests
- Refresher lessons
- Test preparation
- Test car hire
- Pass Plus courses

## Vehicle
- Mercedes-Benz A-Class automatic with dual controls

## Pricing
- First 2 hours: £70
- Pay As You Go: £38 per hour
- 10-Hour Block: £340 (£34 per hour)
- 20-Hour Block: £679
- Intensive Pass Course: £650 to £950 (12 to 30 hours)
- Pass Plus: £250 per course (was £280)
- Test car hire: £150 per test
- Klarna Pay in 3 available
